feat(components): [date-picker] add quarter picker (#24490)

* feat(components): [date-picker] add quarter picker types

Introduce quarter, quarters and quarterrange parity with year/month
pickers, including panel UI, range selection, disabled-date semantics,
docs, styles and tests.

* fix(components): [date-picker] fix quarters and quarterrange bugs

- Make quarters multi-select input readonly with comma-separated display
- Use first available date in quarter for quarterrange selection
- Prevent year pick from overwriting quarters v-model array

* fix(components): [date-picker] fix quarter input parsing and docs

- Fallback to format parsing for default quarter strings in user input
- Add type version tag and show-footer quarters in documentation
- Open picker before disabledDate test assertions
- Remove redundant quarterOfYear imports to align with month/year panels

* refactor(components): [date-picker] use loose parse format whitelist

Replace [Q] format heuristic with isLooseDefaultParseFormat so default
quarter strings use strict dayjs parsing while existing types keep loose parse.

* fix(components): [date-picker] validate disabled quarterrange input

Reject manually typed quarter ranges when disabledDate fully disables a quarter.
Add a regression test to keep manual input aligned with panel selection.

* fix(components): [date-picker] normalize typed quarterrange input

Normalize typed quarter ranges with getValidDateOfQuarter to match panel clicks.
Add a regression test for partial disabledDate manual input.

* fix(components): [date-picker] normalize typed single quarter input

Normalize quarter manual input with getValidDateOfQuarter under partial disabledDate.
Add a regression test to keep typed input aligned with panel selection.

* fix(components): [date-picker] normalize quarter keyboard navigation

Normalize quarter keyboard targets with getValidDateOfQuarter under partial disabledDate.
Add a regression test to keep keyboard selection aligned with panel clicks.

* fix(components): [date-picker] fix quarters confirm disabled state

Use quarter-level disabled checks for quarters confirm button so
value-format roundtrips no longer mis-disable partially available quarters.

* refactor(components): [date-picker] simplify quarter table rows

Extract quarter cell helpers to reduce rows computed complexity without
changing selection, range, or disabled behavior.

* fix(components): [date-picker] zero time for quarters and quarterrange

Normalize quarter picks to start of day so quarters and quarterrange
match single quarter behavior, and add regression tests.

* refactor(components): [date-picker] show quarters in one row

Align the quarter table with month and year pickers by rendering Q1-Q4
in a single row, adjust keyboard navigation, and add a layout test.

* chore(locale): add quarterTablePrompt translations

* style(components): margin for picker panel content

* style(theme-chalk): scope quarter picker content margin

* style(theme-chalk): reduce quarter table cell width to 48px

Narrow the quarter picker pill width so Q1–Q4 aligns better with the
year (60px) and month (54px) selection tiers.

* docs(docs): clarify quarter type version tags in date-picker

Move the 2.14.3 badge from the type prop name to its description so
only quarter, quarters, and quarterrange are marked as new values.

* docs(docs): restore panel-change event description

Revert the panel-change docs text to the original navigation-button
wording across date-picker, date-picker-panel, and datetime-picker.

* docs(docs): fix custom-icon demo responsive grid layout

Use a non-overlapping CSS grid for the date-picker custom icon example
so borders and column spans stay correct on desktop, tablet, and mobile.

* docs(docs): regroup other-measurements demo by selection mode

Split single-select and multi-select pickers into left and right columns
and fix in-column dividers for four stacked blocks per side.

* refactor(components): [date-picker] group quarter panel local types

Move QuarterRangeContext and RangePickValue to the top of their files
per review feedback.

* fix(components): [date-picker] fix quarterrange hover highlight

Listen to mouseover and reset hover dedup state on mouseleave so range
preview updates when re-entering a quarter cell from outside the panel.

* test(components): [date-picker] align quarterrange hover regression test

Drop redundant mouseover listener and test mouseleave hover dedup reset
with mousemove re-entry instead of mouseover-only coverage.

* refactor(components): [date-picker] align quarter range compare

Replace quarterIndex range flags with dayjs isSameOrAfter/isSameOrBefore
at quarter granularity to match month and year picker tables.

* refactor(components): [date-picker] simplify quarter table row logic

Use cellIndex directly for the single-row quarter table and remove
redundant toQuarterIndex, lastRow, and outer row loop.

* refactor(components): [date-picker] demote quarter lastColumn to let

lastColumn is hover dedup state only and does not drive rendering.

* fix(components): [date-picker] fix quarterrange shortcut disabledDate

Validate shortcut ranges before pick and disable invalid shortcut buttons.
Add shared picker-panel shortcut disabled styles.

* refactor(components): [date-picker] flatten quarter table to 1d cells

Use a one-dimensional cell array and a single table row per review feedback.

* fix(components): [date-picker] honor disabledDate in quarter shortcuts

Validate quarter and quarters shortcut picks and disable invalid sidebar buttons.

* refactor(components): [date-picker] dedupe quarter shortcut validation

Extract isSelectableQuarterDate and avoid resolving shortcut values twice on click.

* refactor(components): [date-picker] drop redundant quarter startOf day

Input is already normalized to start of day before getValidDateOfQuarter.

* revert(components): [date-picker] drop shortcut disabledDate checks

Align quarter shortcuts with date/month/year: leave disabledDate and
shortcuts consistency to consumers. Keep quarters shortcut emit as array.

* fix(components): [date-picker] normalize quarter shortcut picks

Align quarter/quarters/quarterrange shortcuts with click and typed input by
running normalizeQuarterDate before emit for partial disabledDate cases.

* fix(components): [date-picker] skip panel-change on quarter pick

Only emit panel-change for panel navigation; leave month pick for a follow-up.

* fix(components): [date-picker] toggle quarters on keyboard pick

Use the same add/remove path as click when Enter/Space activates a quarter cell.

* fix(components): [date-picker] fix quarters keyboard focus nav

* refactor(components): [date-picker] address review feedback

Bump quarter docs version to 2.14.4 and simplify shortcut/parse helpers.

* refactor: simplify branch

* refactor(components): [date-picker] drop quarter shortcut normalize

Align quarter shortcuts with month/year by emitting raw values, reuse
the shared range shortcut handler, and remove redundant disabled checks.

* style(theme-chalk): [date-picker] address quarter picker review feedback

Drop unsupported :has usage, restore shortcut hover styles, add a
dedicated quarterrange editor width token, and widen quarter cell margins.

* docs(components): [date-picker] bump quarter API version tags to 2.14.5

* chore: tweak

fix(components): [select/v2] hide empty input-wrapper only when multiple (#24177)

fix(components): [select/select-v2] only hide empty input-wrapper in multiple mode

#23394 added an `is-hidden` rule on `__input-wrapper` that fires whenever
`states.inputValue` is empty and the select is not focused, regardless of
`multiple`. The hidden style sets `position: absolute`, taking the wrapper
out of the flex flow. The placeholder element is also `position: absolute`,
so in single `filterable` mode (without a value, before focus) the
`__selection` container has no in-flow content left and collapses to zero
width — visible inside auto-sized form-item layouts.

The original goal of #23394 was to stop the empty multi-select input row
from forcing an extra line, so guard that branch with `multiple`.

closes #24167
